prompt:
Character reference sheet, one wide image in two parts, photorealistic photograph. LEFT two-thirds: full-body turnaround of the same person, three views side by side at identical scale: front view, exact 90-degree side view, exact 180-degree back view, relaxed A-pose. RIGHT third: close-up head-and-shoulders portrait of the SAME person facing camera, mouth closed. Plain light-grey background, soft even studio light at a neutral white balance, no shadows, healthy natural skin with real texture, not airbrushed, no text, no labels, no watermark.
The person: George, a fictional 55-year-old, Natalie's weak-willed father, head of the Quinn family, remarried to Lauren; the face, skin and build of exactly that age, which the role does not change. Appearance: An ordinary-looking Caucasian man of 55, about 180 cm, of average build with a slight middle-age softness at the waist. He has a squarish face with soft jowls, mild lines across the forehead and at the eyes, tired kind brown eyes and a clean-shaven chin. Short salt-and-pepper grey hair is neatly combed back. He wears a thin gold wedding band.. Wearing one outfit only: A charcoal-grey fine-knit button cardigan over a plain white collared shirt, grey wool trousers and brown leather loafers.. Signature colour: grey. In the close-up a calm, attractive expression with bright, intelligent eyes and only a hint of: Conflict-avoidant and henpecked. He still feels for his ex-wife and his daughter, but he always gives in to Lauren, because he owes his comfortable life to her.; no tears. The full-body views keep the body's build and proportions as the appearance gives them, head-to-body ratio included, never slimmer. Cast as a commercial live-action short drama: a lead (the heroine, the hero) or a young adult woman in a prominent role is a strikingly beautiful or handsome, camera-ready actor, with the figure, make-up and hair the appearance gives; any other supporting role is an ordinary-looking person of that age.
The outfit is identical in every view and in the close-up: the same garments, accessories and details on the same side of the body, seen from that view's angle (an earring on the left ear stays on the left ear; a tie, a pocket square, gloves or hair ribbons are in every view or in none). Garments are plain, with no logo, brand mark, or printed letters or numbers.

Avoid: a different face between the views, an older-looking or younger-looking face than 55, doll-like face, a second outfit, extra people, extra limbs, text or labels.
